groups.name: Inception
groups.profile: Little-documented extortion brand (no Ransomware.live profile) that posts household-name US firms with long data inventories and 24–48-h Tox deadlines; RedPacket has called its claims unverified (№87).
groups.sectors: Financial Services, Manufacturing, Retail & E-Commerce, Sector not disclosed (feed: Other), Technology

groups.name: Orova
groups.profile: Leak site first seen 2026-07-07 (Ransomware.live; maps it to Valid Accounts, T1078); posts batches of Asian SMEs with company blurbs only. Today five names at 13:52–13:54 UTC.
groups.countries: Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam

groups.name: PixelLeaks
groups.profile: Posts sector-only teasers, then names the organisation, with fixed publication deadlines and itemised record lists. Today it posted five sector teasers at 09:19 UTC (RansomLook) and named all five at 23:16–23:32 UTC (deadline 30 Nov).

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS since May 2023 (CISA advisory AA23-319A); hits healthcare, education, government and legal; publishes large file inventories, as with today’s 1.87 TB library dump.
groups.sectors: Agriculture and Food Production, Education, Professional Services

groups.name: Aurora
groups.profile: Newer leak site posting long write-ups with registry details and partly redacted item lists; seen daily in recent issues.

groups.name: Everest
groups.profile: Russian-speaking extortion crew active since late 2020; also sells initial access; valid-credential/RDP intrusions. Listings often carry “[AI generated]” profiles and no proof.

groups.name: Puppeteer
groups.profile: Not tracked by Ransomware.live (its group API returns 404). Today two bare domain listings on RansomLook only.

groups.name: The Gentlemen
groups.profile: RaaS since mid-2025; Go-based locker, domain-wide deployment via Group Policy. Today’s two names are RansomLook-only.

groups.name: Anubis
groups.profile: RaaS active since December 2024 with an optional destructive “wipe mode”; heavy healthcare focus.

groups.name: MetaEncryptor
groups.profile: Ransomware group first seen mid-2023 (Ransomware.live); targets mid-to-large firms in legal, technology, logistics, manufacturing and finance; AES-256/RSA-2048 encryption, double extortion.

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Prolific RaaS (aka Agenda) since 2022; Rust/Go lockers, VMware ESXi targeting, double extortion. Quiet today, with one posting.

groups.name: Whitearmor
groups.profile: Data-theft site tracked since Oct 2026; earlier claims include Colombian clinics (№93).
